reply.summary: Valaminu is a cheerful throwing blade with a wing-shaped body, fused with a circuit board by two teenage tinkerers. Whenever danger nears, it banks around corners and returns to its makers with a chirp.

feats.scene: Valaminu curves through a row of cardboard targets and clatters back into a waiting glove.
Valaminu bounces off a brick wall with only a dented edge.

reply.summary: Vetaniu is a deckhand who bends sound into hard pulses, a skill picked up while serving on a rogue crew. Between storms he hums the waves flat and shatters crates with a shout.

feats.scene: Vetaniu focuses a shriek that splinters the mast of a rival skiff.
Vetaniu is thrown against the rail and gets back up winded.

reply.summary: Siunel is a bar regular who fakes a famous villain's reputation, armed with a humming prong-shaped sound weapon he once gambled away. Nobody has the heart to tell him the act fooled no one.

feats.scene: Siunel fires his humming prongs and knocks a bottle shelf into the mirror.
Siunel takes a thrown stool across the back and keeps bluffing.

reply.summary: Ticosti is a blond brawler whose glowing ring of poison fumes can wrap a victim and squeeze. Across small farm towns she raids with her gang, until a streak of speed burns the ring away.

feats.scene: Ticosti tightens her fume ring around a farmer until he drops to his knees.
Ticosti shrugs off a thrown tractor wheel before her ring fades.

reply.summary: Oraosa sells smuggled guns from behind a showroom desk and sprints on mechanical legs that spring him over parked vans. Beneath the polite smile he is a crippled dealer who trusts steel more than people.

feats.scene: Oraosa drives a kick through a car door as he vaults a showroom floor.
Oraosa pounds down an alley faster than any sprinter on the block.

reply.summary: Caeoleon is a yellow-eyed adventurer who loves aimless trips and flies without any destination. She carries a pair of bangles, a small crown and a rope that makes captives blurt truth, and one day she simply stiffens into stone.

feats.scene: Caeoleon swings her rope and flings a dozen guards across a plaza.
Caeoleon stands unmoved as a toppled column breaks over her shoulders.

reply.summary: Iuill is a pale, black-eyed brawler who flips, tumbles and hurls whatever she finds, soaring above the toy-brick streets. She belongs to a rowdy crowd of misfit duplicates and picks fights for fun.

feats.scene: Iuill lobs a stack of bricks and flattens a tower of crates.
Iuill lands from a rooftop dive and walks off laughing.

reply.summary: Nelcorca is a mirror-flawed giant who decided he had not been flawed enough and tore his own home world apart as a grown man. Having fled to a distant planet, he trampled a department store before ending his own life.

feats.scene: Nelcorca shatters his cube-shaped home with a single desperate blow.
Nelcorca walks out of the collapse of his world without a scratch.

reply.summary: Reonau is a first flawed duplicate who reverses every custom, hating beauty and loving ugliness, and married a duplicate reporter. Eventually he rose to guard his chalky cube of a world.

feats.scene: Reonau punches a hill into gravel while shouting backwards slogans.
Reonau stands at the center of a quarry blast and yawns.

reply.summary: Stoanniu is a clumsy, glowering failure of a lab experiment who joined a cabal of villains. Where a hero's gaze might warm, his glare freezes whatever it lands on, and he flies in a rage over the city.

feats.scene: Stoanniu freezes a whole tower solid with one furious stare.
Stoanniu is pummeled by three thugs and keeps smiling.

reply.summary: Rnilu is a wonky, white-skinned giant who wants only to help yet muddles every rescue. He blows frost, stares ice and flies through toy cities, and he longs to reach the sun for reasons nobody follows.

feats.scene: Rnilu exhales frost across a harbor and locks every boat in ice.
Rnilu bounces back from a falling bridge span, thrilled at the noise.

reply.summary: Rusmilnus is a pale, dark-eyed raider with a body that follows no known rules, swinging weapons at a besieged cliff fortress. Among a rabble of outlaws he is just another soldier of the great army.

feats.scene: Rusmilnus hacks through a gate with a single wild swing.
Rusmilnus takes a volley of arrows to the chest and presses on.

reply.summary: Taulicor is a botched copy born from a city-wide blackout, freed from a cell to smash storefronts and attack crowds. Though his raw force rivals his source's, he fights without craft and finally gets spared.

feats.scene: Taulicor flattens an apartment block with a hammering of fists.
Taulicor walks through a wall of police fire and keeps stomping.

reply.summary: Tautirne is a pale-skinned petty criminal belonging to a band of mirrored heroes who do everything the wrong way round. She wears a glum smirk and a stolen sash.

feats.scene: Tautirne flips a parked scooter into a shopfront.
Tautirne laughs off a collision with a lamppost.

reply.summary: Veotiaam is a green-eyed blond hero who shuns the sea and shouts at fish from dry land. His team rescues people by accident and returns home to cheers it cannot understand.

feats.scene: Veotiaam hoists a rowboat overhead and hurls it at a harbor wall.
Veotiaam shrugs when a crate lands on his head.

reply.summary: Reoialcar is a grey-skinned member of a mirrored hero league who dwells on a cube-shaped world. A giant vessel from the sky crushes him with the rest of his team in a single moment.

feats.scene: Reoialcar fires a wobbly volley of arrows at the sky vessel.
Reoialcar endures the first shockwave of the landing before it ends him.

reply.summary: Aucoor is a worst-of-all sleuth, formed by a bumbling giant as a partner on trips between two worlds. He loves chaos, even sided with a clown, and gets sent home for tidying a place that should stay broken.

feats.scene: Aucoor hurls a smoke pellet that fills a ballroom with confusion.
Aucoor falls through a skylight and complains about the glass.

reply.summary: Tumtoril is a chalky copy of a night-prowling detective, spawned by a sun-struck creator to fill a cube-shaped planetoid. He and his team of fellow copies tried to crush a rampaging monster by dropping their own base on it.

feats.scene: Tumtoril helps tip an entire hovering fortress onto a beast.
Tumtoril stumbles out of a wrecked room, dust sheeting off his shoulders.

reply.summary: Taauinu is a crumbling-skinned inhabitant of a mirrored hero league on a tilted cube world, imitating an insect-themed champion. Like his teammates, he is misshapen and brief.

feats.scene: Taauinu smashes a stone bench with one overhead swing.
Taauinu takes a falling beam and cracks it in half.

reply.summary: Tuvastu is a black-haired knockoff of a lightning-summoning champion, living among a reversed hero society. He says his magic word backwards and nothing much happens.

feats.scene: Tuvastu leaps off a ledge and cracks the pavement with a stomp.
Tuvastu sits unharmed under a toppled statue.

reply.summary: Serrni is the slowest runner on a cube world, covering about two inches every hour, which his neighbors call a record. When a visitor needed ignition for a rocket, his friction supplied the heat.

feats.scene: Serrni sets off across a square and is still there at nightfall.
Serrni warms a launch engine until it roars off the pad.

reply.summary: Tetis is a pale, sleepy runner who brags of being the laziest of all and yawns through each rescue. When he does move he is quick, which rarely helps the team he joins.

feats.scene: Tetis bolts across a field in a blur and then dozes on the far side.
Tetis tips a market stall with a lazy shove.

reply.summary: Meoran is a grey-skinned runner who was copied from a wind-footed champion and then joined a squad that tried to flatten a monster with a flying base. Tests of his speed are rarely recorded.

feats.scene: Meoran helps heave a floating headquarters down on a monster.
Meoran staggers out of a crater, brushing dust from his sleeves.

reply.summary: Tiaeonnau is a blond, black-eyed girl who flies and visits a small town of sidekicks, announcing proudly that she has every talent. She adores her pet duck and her first crush, who moves a little too fast.

feats.scene: Tiaeonnau tosses a toy truck into a hedge from the air.
Tiaeonnau tumbles through a fence and giggles.

reply.summary: Sausese is a brown-haired citizen of a mirrored underworld who owns a glowing ring in his nose that conjures only what he cannot imagine. Since his mind imagines everything, the ring never does a thing.

feats.scene: Sausese strains until a faint green glow flickers and fades.
Sausese is knocked into a barrel and sits there puzzled.

reply.summary: Iumnti is a grey, feathered-style duplicate who shrieks instead of speaking and fights beside a squad of mirrored heroes. She helped drop a flying headquarters onto a monster and perished soon after.

feats.scene: Iumnti dives from above and rams a pillar down on a crowd of raiders.
Iumnti takes a falling wall on her back and shrieks defiantly.

reply.summary: Ilnacar is a tall winged copy whose skin is a faceted crystal like crumbled chalk, unbothered by sunlight. He wanders a cube-shaped world as an adventurer and reverses every sensible choice.

feats.scene: Ilnacar beats a crystal club against a boulder and splits it.
Ilnacar is buried in a rockslide and climbs out shining.

reply.summary: Telicol is a grey-skinned member of a reversed hero league, a woman who frosts her surroundings just as a famous counterpart does. A giant vessel from above ended her along with her team.

feats.scene: Telicol freezes a fountain solid in a single breath.
Telicol resists the first rumble of the falling vessel before it ends her.

reply.summary: Loole is a green-haired clown reflection who is not mad at all, so he sees no reason to scheme against the heroes of his cube world. Left idle and gloomy, he mostly sits and sighs.

feats.scene: Loole throws a limp pie that barely reaches a bench.
Loole is knocked from a stool and just stays on the floor.

reply.summary: Anlanti is a green-haired grey-skinned clown copy among countless others stamped out by a sun-soaked creator. His thinking runs opposite to logic, and his jokes land backwards.

feats.scene: Anlanti flings a hat full of marbles that scatters across a platform.
Anlanti falls down a stairwell and bounces up grinning.

reply.summary: Llliu is an orange-eyed green-skinned pet beast, freed from an icy vault by a lumbering new owner and carried to a cube world. It has claws, fangs and nimble legs and acts like any excited dog.

feats.scene: Llliu lunges and rakes a steel door open with its claws.
Llliu tumbles from a ledge and trots off wagging.

reply.summary: Nasatum is a red-haired, green-eyed stand-in made for a monster film shot on a cube world. She refuses to kiss the monster, saying she would not even if he were the last man alive, and is sent home.

feats.scene: Nasatum swats a prop torch across a film set.
Nasatum steps out of a collapsed set unharmed.

reply.summary: Sonlorral is a bald, black-eyed schemer who brews a poison to make everyone as hairless as himself and calls himself the greatest hero. He lets loose a secret weapon, a hulking beast that hunts rival copies.

feats.scene: Sonlorral unleashes a monster that levels a whole row of shacks.
Sonlorral takes a falling signpost and keeps lecturing.

reply.summary: Rniiarirn is a grey-skinned, black-eyed wife of a giant on a cube world, scolding the heroes for stopping a planned bombing. She backs lies, injustice and her own odd idea of patriotism.

feats.scene: Rniiarirn slams a stack of ledgers on a desk and splits it.
Rniiarirn is flung into a wall and dusts herself off.

reply.summary: Antereo is a grey-skinned sidekick duplicate, the first of many spawned when a ray struck his mentor. His very first word is goodbye, and a rampaging monster smashes him moments later.

feats.scene: Antereo swings a tiny cape and hits nothing at all.
Antereo is hammered into the ground before he can take a second breath.

reply.summary: Sonnan is a gray-haired, black-eyed junior hero that exists in a daydream, wearing a tool-filled belt and marching with a squad of play-acting youths. He lives on a cube-shaped world.

feats.scene: Sonnan tosses a toy gadget that pops against a wall.
Sonnan tumbles off a sofa and giggles.

reply.summary: Irntiaiu is a brown-haired, black-eyed girl in a daydreamed squad of mirrored youths, a cousin of a fiery space princess. She exists on a cube world only in a child's imagination.

feats.scene: Irntiaiu shoots a crayon-bright blast that fizzles on a toy fort.
Irntiaiu is bumped off a swing and bounces.

reply.summary: Osallotel is a flying, nearly indestructible youth from a distant future who was turned away by a club of young heroes. He answered by stamping out mocking copies and demanding that worthless stones be turned to coal.

feats.scene: Osallotel punches through a vault door and sends a stack of crates tumbling.
Osallotel stays standing after a whole cliff collapses on him.
Osallotel streaks over a canyon faster than sound.

reply.summary: Irnvalval is a black-haired, white-skinned giant resident of a cube world, wandering streets with no plan. A blue mineral sickens him, like all his kind.

feats.scene: Irnvalval bats a barrel across a street and breaks a window.
Irnvalval is struck by a cart and does not notice.

reply.summary: Ulren is a blond grey-skinned toy maker copy who locks rivals into a stronghold built by his creator. He builds absurd inventions and takes pride in every failed one.

feats.scene: Ulren winds up a clockwork robot that bursts through a plank door.
Ulren falls out of a workshop window and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Eonla is a warrior woman of a mirrored underworld who, doing the opposite of her model, turned from a living figure into a hardened clay statue. Her mind is fuzzy, and she now simply stands on a plinth.

feats.scene: Eonla swings a clay arm and cracks a post.
Eonla survives a tumble from her plinth with a single chip.

reply.summary: Luunnu is a tall, blue-eyed, black-haired woman, a pale reflection of a famous warrior who lives on a cube world. A certain blue mineral robs her of strength.

feats.scene: Luunnu hammers a stone post flat with her fists.
Luunnu is dropped from a tower and strolls off.

reply.summary: Inlansa is a grey-skinned, black-haired fighter who carries a rope that forces its captives to lie. She dropped a flying fortress on a monster alongside her team.

feats.scene: Inlansa and her allies drop a hovering stronghold on a monster.
Inlansa stands up after a hard collision with a stone arch.

reply.summary: Monlanall is a brown-haired fellow in a yellow and black costume who carries a candlestick emblem and a useless ring. He is a coward, and the hero crowd celebrates him for it.

feats.scene: Monlanall waves his ring and produces a puff of weak light.
Monlanall crashes through a fence and hides under it.

reply.summary: Ntean is a black-haired, pale woman who chants her spells in reverse, living on a cube-shaped world. Whatever she conjures turns out the opposite of her wish.

feats.scene: Ntean mutters a backwards verse and a bench flips over.
Ntean lands in a flower bed and waves.

reply.summary: Loramo is a yellow-eyed, brown-haired woman who resents her husband and son and fights them constantly, firing guns and swinging powerful fists. She is married to a giant and mothers a young hero.

feats.scene: Loramo swings a table at her family and splits it against a wall.
Loramo takes a thrown anvil and shakes her head.

reply.summary: Lotaceo is a white-eyed, blonde brute who can take on any shape yet dislikes his own face too much to try. He fights beside a gang of reversed heroes and keeps his old features in every form.

feats.scene: Lotaceo stretches into a mallet and smashes a truck door.
Lotaceo flows around a swung beam and reforms unhurt.

reply.summary: Tatavi is a white-eyed, black-haired inventor of dim ideas who throws sticky globs and weapons at a team of heroes. His genius is for stupidity and his gadgets rarely work as meant.

feats.scene: Tatavi lobs a glob that glues a car to a lamppost.
Tatavi is bounced off a billboard and squints.

reply.summary: Starntel is a stretchy, black-haired villain who flings his own arms and legs like projectiles at rivals, then watches the pieces rot away. He answers to a silly nickname and always loses parts.

feats.scene: Starntel fires a detached fist that dents a truck.
Starntel is flattened by a roller and inflates back.

reply.summary: Ausul is a dark-haired boy knight who rides a loyal steed and speaks in flowery boasts, courting maidens who do not want him. He sprays rivals with water pistols and helps rescue a dying world.

feats.scene: Ausul charges on his steed and topples a watchman's booth.
Ausul is thrown from the saddle and bounces up unhurt.
